lessons.title: Frontend-Backend API URL Mismatch Causes Silent 404
lessons.description: Frontend calls /api/v1/one-click/test and /api/v1/one-click/{id}/progress but backend controller was at /api/v1/oneclick/scan (no hyphen, different path). The 404 gets silently caught in try/catch, causing 0 findings with no error visible to user.
lessons.fix: Added /api/v1/one-click/test (POST) and /api/v1/one-click/{id}/progress (GET) endpoints to OneClickController, changed base path from /api/v1/oneclick to /api/v1

lessons.title: Kafka Blocking Breaks Async Scan Execution
lessons.description: Kafka producer blocks 60s (default max.block.ms) when broker unreachable. Since publishEvent is called synchronously in the scan execution path, ALL scans hang waiting for Kafka metadata timeout. Even with retries=0, the send() call blocks for max.block.ms.
lessons.fix: Excluded KafkaAutoConfiguration.class from @SpringBootApplication. publishEvent now checks kafkaTemplate!=null before sending. Local dev works without Kafka.

lessons.title: Lombok Builder.Default vs NOT NULL DB Constraints
lessons.description: Scan entity has @Column(nullable = false) scanType but OneClickService.start() creates Scan via builder without setting scanType. DB migration enforces NOT NULL. Always set all NOT NULL columns when using builder.
lessons.fix: Added .scanType(detected) to Scan builder in OneClickService.start()

lessons.title: Vite Proxy Port Must Match Backend Port
lessons.description: Vite proxy was pointing to port 8081 (docker-compose) but local backend runs on 8080. This causes all API calls to fail silently.
lessons.fix: Changed proxy target in vite.config.ts from port 8081 to 8080

lessons.title: React Controlled Input + Playwright fill() = No State Update
lessons.description: Playwright's fill() doesn't trigger React's onChange handler for controlled inputs. The actual target scanned remains the default placeholder value, not the user-entered URL.
lessons.fix: Use API directly to trigger scans instead of browser automation for testing. Or use page.locator().fill() with proper event dispatch.

lessons.title: Recharts Cell Components Unreachable in JSDOM
lessons.description: Recharts <Cell fill> components at Dashboard.tsx lines 48/62 are unreachable in JSDOM test environment because SVG rendering differs from browser. This is a known limitation.
lessons.fix: Accept as known limitation. 92.85% branch coverage is realistic ceiling for Dashboard.tsx in JSDOM.

lessons.title: Spring @Async Default Thread Pool is Limited
lessons.description: Spring Boot default @Async uses SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor or a fixed pool. With 8 parallel scans each doing multiple publishEvent calls, thread starvation can occur. Old QUEUED scans from failed runs consume threads.
lessons.fix: Configure explicit thread pool for @Async. Consider @Async with custom Executor bean.

lessons.title: Docker Kafka Port Mapping vs Internal Listener
lessons.description: Kafka container maps 9094->9092 externally, but Spring connects to localhost:9094. The Kafka broker may not be reachable from host network depending on Docker networking. Always verify Kafka connectivity before enabling.
lessons.fix: Disabled Kafka auto-config for local dev. In production, use proper broker addresses and verify connectivity.

lessons.title: Backend 0% Coverage Classes Have Tests That Don't Run
lessons.description: ScanService (0% = 1488 missed), OneClickService (0% = 1058 missed), OneClickController (0% = 235 missed) show 0% JaCoCo coverage despite having test files. Root causes: (1) OneClickControllerTest uses @WebMvcTest but doesn't mock OneClickService bean → context fails to load. (2) ScanService tests may exist but use wrong context. Must check if tests actually compile+run before adding more.
lessons.fix: Fix OneClickControllerTest by adding @MockBean OneClickService. Verify ScanService tests compile and run. Run `mvn test -Dtest=ClassName` per class to verify.

lessons.title: Frontend-Backend API Path Alignment Is Already Correct
lessons.description: Dashboard (/api/v1/dashboard/posture), SBOM (/api/v1/sboms), Container (/api/v1/containers), Database (/api/v1/databases), Browser (/api/v1/browser-extensions) — all frontend paths match backend @RequestMapping. Initial curl test with wrong paths (singular/plural) gave false 404. Always check @RequestMapping annotation before assuming mismatch.
lessons.fix: No code change needed. Frontend and backend paths are already aligned.

lessons.title: Backend Coverage Focus: Top 5 Gap Classes
lessons.description: To reach 100% backend coverage, focus on these 5 classes first (they account for ~90% of missed instructions): (1) ScanService 0% → 1488 missed, (2) OneClickService 0% → 1058 missed, (3) DastAnalyzer 68% → 631 missed, (4) ApiAnalyzer 60% → 267 missed, (5) OneClickController 0% → 235 missed. Total ~3679 missed instructions out of ~6542 total gap.
lessons.fix: Write unit tests for each class, ensuring JaCoCo reports them. Test with `mvn test -Dtest=ClassName jacoco:report` to verify incremental progress.
